blocks.text: Condo buildings in Chilliwack Downtown
No SnapStats for Chilliwack. CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only, with no sub-area tables. Live-page board defect flagged at the top.
Ivy Green — 45775 Spadina Avenue

55+ freehold strata condo building: 24 condos, 3 storeys, built 1994, plan LMS1336, self-managed, pets not allowed (strata-manager building record). Listings describe it as a "55+ age-restricted apartment" in Chilliwack Downtown, freehold strata, with in-suite laundry.
Spadina Regency — 45765 Spadina Avenue

55+ freehold strata condo building, concrete construction, built 1989; the building directory records a 26-unit development, pets allowed. Listings state "55+ building where rentals and pets are permitted," with secure underground parking, elevator, clubhouse, workshop and a guest suite; the rental line in any older directory text is in any case void since November 24, 2022.
Chilliwack Gardens — 45749 Spadina Avenue

Low-rise strata, Apartment/Condo sub-type, labelled Chilliwack Downtown in listings, described as "rental-friendly (no age restrictions), No Pets," professionally managed, with heat and hot water included in the strata fee per the listing checked. Year built — CONFLICT IN SOURCES: one current listing states 1980; another states 1979 (1979–1980 not confirmed). Unit count: Not confirmed. This is the trap on the Spadina corridor: same street as two genuine 55+ buildings, opposite rules.
The Willows — 45893 Chesterfield Avenue

Apartment form confirmed by listings and by the building record: Strata Plan BCS3330, sub-area Chilliwack Downtown, Apartment dwelling type, with secure underground parking and in-suite laundry in listing text. Year built — CONFLICT IN SOURCES: the building record states 2009; several current listings state 2008 (2008–2009 not confirmed). Unit count: Not confirmed.
Unnamed building — 9000 Birch Street
Year built and published restrictions: Not confirmed (the 2005 advertisement is a presale record, not a completion record).
Unnamed building — 9060 Birch Street

Apartment form confirmed by a current listing: sub-type Apartment, labelled Chilliwack Downtown, built 2009, one block from Five Corners per its listing text. Unit count and published restrictions: Not confirmed.

items.t: Municipally, the same ground is planned through Schedule B3, the Downtown Neighbourhood Plan, of the City's 2050 Official Community Plan, with Schedule D-6 the "Downtown" development permit area. Street-level board boundary: Not verified — CADREB publishes no street-level boundary in the public sources used.

Where the condo stock concentrates: two short corridors — Spadina Avenue (three strata buildings in a row: 45749, 45765 and 45775) and the Birch Street / Chesterfield Avenue / Cheam Avenue pocket by Five Corners (9000 and 9060 Birch Street, The Willows on Chesterfield, Magnolia Manor named on Cheam).
Schools: Chilliwack is SD33. Catchments are address-based and no SD33 locator run for a downtown address is on record, so catchment schools for any specific address are not verified.

Transit: BC Transit's Chilliwack service-improvements notice (December 18, 2025, effective January 4, 2026) records added Sunday-evening service for Route 57 Broadway, Route 53 Fairfield and Route 51, and BC Transit lists Route 66 Fraser Valley Express as serving Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley and Burnaby with daily service.

Health care: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Rd, Chilliwack, is a Fraser Health community hospital providing primary, core secondary and some specialty services — it sits just west of the downtown condo corridors.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chilliwack Downtown

items.t: A fourth Spadina building is filed under a different sub-area. Spadina Place (45535 Spadina Ave) is labelled Chilliwack Proper West in current listings, and a house on the same street is also labelled Proper West in listing data — a buyer who searches by sub-area label alone will find the same street filed under two different pages.

Downtown's condo stock splits into two pockets, not one district. The Spadina trio is 1980s–1990s stock by the hospital precinct; the Birch/Chesterfield/Cheam pocket (9000 and 9060 Birch, The Willows, Magnolia Manor) is 2000s stock by Five Corners and District 1881. Fees, construction and warranty history differ by pocket, not by the "downtown" label.
Two downtown buildings cannot be searched by name — anywhere citable.
The page's board claim is wrong, and its plan wording is only partly confirmed. A buyer valuing infill on that wording needs a City check, not the page copy.

The Willows and Chilliwack Gardens each carry a build-year conflict. The Willows: 2009 in the building record, 2008 in several listings. Chilliwack Gardens: 1980 in one listing, 1979 in another. Neither conflict is resolved here — the strata plan registration record settles each definitively.
There are no SnapStats numbers for Chilliwack Downtown — anyone quoting one is quoting nothing.

items.t: OCP: Chilliwack 2050, Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 — current: Schedule B3 is the Downtown Neighbourhood Plan (adopted June 2010, updated 2025, per the plan record read via search result) articulating the vision for the Downtown Plan Area over 30 years, and Schedule D-6 is the Downtown development permit area, whose guidelines exist to facilitate the Downtown Design Guidelines under s.488(1)(d) of the Local Government Act and to support revitalization of the historic downtown core.

Zoning / subdivision / servicing: Subdivision runs through the City's Approving Officer and the Preliminary Layout Approval process: confirm the parcel's zone, subdivision requirements, servicing and frontage conditions with the Approving Officer for the PID before valuing a split.

City property taxes (2026): notices are mailed annually at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1; a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026, and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Chilliwack Downtown
Local rules that affect duplexes in Chilliwack Downtown

items.t: Zoning (Chilliwack): Chilliwack Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000 governs.

SSMUH position (Chilliwack): Duplexes are the baseline form under the provincial small-scale multi-unit housing framework. Chilliwack's SSMUH amendment is Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395, amending Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, adopted June 18, 2024, allowing 3–4 units on urban-growth-boundary parcels zoned for single-detached and duplex housing.

Under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: A secondary suite is an accessory dwelling unit of not more than 90 m² and less than 40% of the habitable floor space of the building — the lesser of 90 m² and 40% (s.2); only 1 accessory dwelling unit may be located on a lot, and the permitted ADU types include secondary suite, coach house and garden suite (s.4.06(1)); garden suites are capped at a maximum gross floor area of 100 m² (s.4.06(1)(g)); ADU parking is 1 space for a 1-bedroom ADU or any secondary suite and 2 spaces for a 2-or-more-bedroom coach or garden suite (s.5.04).
